dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: This, I'll be considered the one who watches over Lumidouce Harbor for real, right?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Fantastic. No one's secretly trying to get rid of me, or trying to blow up Lumidouce Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: And people have stopped engaging in shady practices like bribery, fraud, or backstabbing.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Peace has been restored to Lumidouce Harbor. Not bad!

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: And I played a big role in it all, too. Even better!

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: I specifically went looking for him later, but the scoundrel had already made off with everything. The house was totally empty, not even a piece of paper left behind.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Hmph... Greedy yet cowardly. He wouldn't dare do anything to me, not unless he had a powerful patron.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: A pity I can't find him now, or I'd show him my special kind of hospitality.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you thinking about hiring more people?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Yes... I'm seriously considering that, and discussing with Lemarcq.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: However... Haha, maybe that shameless Pattyn was right. You won't make a fortune by working with me. I doubt many people would want to get involved.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: But no matter what, I won't take dirty money. Otherwise... I wouldn't be able to sleep at night.
